english.note: Use 競爭 as the all-purpose verb when people rival one another for the same position, prize, or outcome.
Use this when striving means competing or contending with another person or group.

examples.english: Both companies want to compete for this government contract.
examples.traditional: 兩間公司都想競爭呢份政府合約。
examples.jyutping: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 soeng2 ging6 zang1 ni1 fan6 zing3 fu2 hap6 joek3

examples.english: Several big companies strive to win this contract.
examples.traditional: 幾間大公司都喺度競爭呢份合約。
examples.jyutping: gei2 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 dou1 hai2 dou6 ging6 zang1 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3
